correctness.rationale: For length-four codewords over the labelled ternary alphabet, global S3 relabelling yields exactly 14 word orbits, one constant size-three orbit and thirteen nonconstant size-six orbits. Each of 41 target length-five orbits imposes a nonempty incidence-mask intersection on a selected source-orbit subset; constant target words force the constant source orbit. An independent from-scratch Python complete orbit enumeration counted no coverings for r=0,1,2,3,4,5 selected nonconstant orbits, and exactly 37 coverings for r=6 (total size 39). Reversal fixes five of those 37 and pairs the remaining 32, giving exactly 21 equivalence classes. It directly checked that all 243 length-five targets have a deletion yielding one of the 31 explicitly supplied unrestricted codewords, so symmetry penalty >=8, without asserting 31 unrestricted optimality. This is a finite exhaustive proof because the orbit equivalence and the 14/41 incidence parametrization are exhaustive; it is not inference from a sample. Independently computed counts agree with source Python/C++ algorithm descriptions.
